\textit{Note.} Categories: BEST = a stated ordering puts it first; TIED = no ordering is claimed (or all pass the same criteria); BEHIND = a stated ordering or a failed similarity verdict puts it below; FAILED = does not bound position; PASSED = met its pre-registered criteria with no comparison (L, FGO only); N/A = not run.
